battle.name: 赤瓜礁海戰
battle.brief: 一九八八年三月十四日，南沙九章群礁赤瓜礁，中方502、531、556三艘護衛艦與越南三艘軍艦在礁上對峙後互相開火，越方兩船沉沒、一船擱淺，中方僅一人手臂中彈。卡面這架一九八〇年的殲-8II是解放軍唯一的高空高速截擊機，此役只在北部基地擔任警戒攔截，未能覆蓋礁區。

kit.name: 殲八II戰鬥機
kit.history: J-8 II是中國人民解放軍空軍的單座全天候截擊機，編入航空兵師下屬殲擊機團，主要執行高空高速攔截、警戒與制空任務。

countries: 交戰的一方是中國人民解放軍海軍南海艦隊，配合同時代空軍與海軍航空兵的空中力量。作戰主體是南海艦隊榆林基地參謀長陳偉文率領的三艦編隊：南充號（502，65型「江南」級，標準排水量約1150噸）居前逼近赤瓜礁，鷹潭號（531，053K型「江東」級，約1674噸）與湘潭號（556，053H1型「江湖II」級，約1565噸）分別控制鬼喊礁與瓊礁方向；同批還有東海艦隊派出的紹興號（510）、韶關號（553）與南拖147號拖船在永暑礁、華陽礁一帶警戒護航，後方基地則承擔油料、淡水與建設物資的補給。另一方是越南人民軍海軍第一七一艦隊與一二五運輸旅：美制LST登陸艦「歸仁」號（HQ-505，標準排水量約1651噸）與武裝運輸船HQ-604、HQ-605（排水量368噸，滿載822噸），載運117名武裝人員，計劃在赤瓜礁、鬼喊礁、瓊礁三處建立高腳屋。兩邊的指揮架構都極簡：越方由運輸旅長陳德俊中校統一號令，登礁小組由陳文祥少尉帶領；中方以陳偉文的編隊指揮部為核心，艦上政委李楚群、副槍炮長楊志亮等人對開火時機有直接決定權。事前沒有第三國斡旋，一九八八年三月十二日至十三日雙方只在電報與喊話中交涉。
countriesEn: One of the belligerents was the South Sea Fleet of the People's Liberation Army Navy, backed at the time by the air force and by the naval air arm. The operational core was a three-ship group led by Chen Weiwen, then chief of staff of the Yulin base of the South Sea Fleet: Nanchong (502, Type 065 Jiangnan class, standard displacement about 1,150 tons) leading the approach to Johnson South Reef, with Yingtan (531, Type 053K Jiangdong class, about 1,674 tons) and Xiangtan (556, Type 053H1 Jianghu-II class, about 1,565 tons) covering the directions of Collins Reef and Lansdowne Reef. The same force included Shaoxing (510) and Shaoguan (553) sent by the East Sea Fleet and the tug Nantuo-147, guarding the area around Fiery Cross Reef and Huayang Reef, while the shore bases in the rear supplied fuel, fresh water and construction material. The other side was the 171st Flotilla and the 125th Transport Brigade of the Vietnam People's Army Navy: the American-built LST landing ship Quy Nhon (HQ-505, standard displacement about 1,651 tons) and the armed transports HQ-604 and HQ-605 (displacement 368 tons, 822 tons fully loaded), carrying 117 armed personnel with the intention of establishing stilt houses on Johnson South Reef, Collins Reef and Lansdowne Reef. Both command structures were minimal. On the Vietnamese side the Transport Brigade commander, Lieutenant Colonel Tran Duc Thong, issued the orders and Second Lieutenant Tran Van Phuong led the landing party. On the Chinese side the group command post under Chen Weiwen was the centre of decision, and the political commissar Li Chuqun and the deputy gunnery officer Yang Zhiliang of Nanchong had a direct say in when to open fire. No third party mediated: between 12 and 13 March 1988 the two sides communicated only by radio message and by hail.
people: 中方最關鍵的人是陳偉文。一九八八年三月，他是南海艦隊榆林基地參謀長，基地司令員為楊玉書，率南充號、鷹潭號、湘潭號三艦赴九章群島，事後記功晉升少將。整場戰鬥由他以編隊指揮員身分定奪：三月十三日清晨派南充號先行前往赤瓜礁，十四日清晨以鷹潭號、湘潭號分別壓制鬼喊礁與瓊礁方向，下令三船同時射擊的時機，戰後又因忌憚越南空軍支援而令編隊迅速撤出戰場。南充號政委李楚群帶七名士兵駕小艇繞過越方運輸船逼近礁盤，下令砍斷繫住越軍登礁小船的纜繩，瓦解越方登礁人員的退路；副槍炮長楊志亮在爭奪旗幟時推開了瞄準自己的越軍槍支，左臂被子彈射穿，成為中方唯一的傷者。鷹潭號反潛兵班長杜祥厚拔出插在礁盤上的越南國旗，成為雙方衝突的導火線。越方由海軍副司令黃友泰中將與前進指揮所司令、兼第四軍區司令員甲文綱中將坐鎮，一二五運輸旅副旅長陳德聰中校（Trần Đức Thông，陣亡）統一調度，少尉Trần Văn Phương與阮文秀（Nguyễn Văn Tu）、阮文良（Nguyễn Văn Lạnh）負責登礁植旗與護衛；HQ-604艦長武飛儲大尉陣亡，HQ-605艦長黎令山大尉、HQ-505艦長武輝禮大尉各守一船。更高層面上，海軍司令員劉華清在自傳中記載，控制永暑礁、華陽礁等六處礁盤的決定由中央軍委作出，並得到鄧小平批准。外交上，中方只向越南駐華使館遞交一份抗議照會，處理相當低調。
peopleEn: The central figure on the Chinese side was Chen Weiwen. In March 1988 he was chief of staff of the Yulin base of the South Sea Fleet and led Nanchong, Yingtan and Xiangtan into the Union Banks group; he was later decorated and promoted to rear admiral. The whole engagement was decided in his capacity as group commander: he sent Nanchong ahead to Johnson South Reef early on 13 March, covered the directions of Collins Reef and Lansdowne Reef with Yingtan and Xiangtan in the small hours of the 14th, ordered the moment when all three ships would fire, and after the action pulled the group out of the battle area because he feared a Vietnamese air response. Li Chuqun, the political commissar of Nanchong, took seven men in a small boat around the Vietnamese transport to close on the reef and had the mooring line of the Vietnamese landing boat cut, cutting off the retreat of the men on the reef. The deputy gunnery officer Yang Zhiliang pushed aside a Vietnamese rifle that was aimed at him during the struggle over the flag and took a bullet through his left arm; he was the only Chinese casualty of the day. Du Xianghou, an anti-submarine rating of Yingtan, pulled the Vietnamese flag off the reef, and that act became the trigger for the clash. On the Vietnamese side, the deputy commander of the navy and the chief of the forward command post, who was also commander of the Fourth Military Region, ran the operation from ashore, while the deputy commander of the 125th Transport Brigade, Lieutenant Colonel Tran Duc Thong (Trần Đức Thông), who was killed in the action, commanded the ships, and Second Lieutenant Tran Van Phuong (Trần Văn Phương), with Nguyen Van Tu (Nguyễn Văn Tu) and Nguyen Van Lanh (Nguyễn Văn Lạnh), planted the flag on the reef and guarded it; the captain of HQ-604 was killed, and the captains of HQ-605 and HQ-505, Li Lingshan and Wu Huili, held their own ships. At the higher level, Admiral Liu Huaqing recorded in his autobiography that the decision to control the six reefs, including Fiery Cross Reef and Huayang Reef, was taken by the Central Military Commission and approved by Deng Xiaoping. Diplomatically, China lodged only a note of protest with the Vietnamese embassy in Beijing and handled the matter with considerable restraint.
kits: 卡面這架殲-8II是解放軍空軍唯一量產的高空高速截擊機，一九八〇年前後開始裝備航空兵師下屬殲擊機團，機頭配火控雷達，可掛載紅外制導空空導彈如紅旗四、紅旗五系列，專責在高空高速域攔截來襲機；同時期的殲-7與殲-5偏向中低空戰鬥與對地攻擊，分工不同。在赤瓜礁衝突裏，殲-8II並不是擊沉越艦的兵器，它的作用在於為遠海艦隊提供一線空中警戒與攔截準備：按事後公開回憶，空軍與海軍航空兵曾以殲-8II在北部與海南方向基地待命，針對可能升空增援的越方戰機進入攔截位置。該型機作戰半徑在同類截擊機中不算短，公開資料常引兩千公里上下，具體數值隨副油箱與載荷而異，但從廣州、湛江、三亞等基地起飛要覆蓋九章群礁上空仍有明顯距離，滯空時間也難以貫穿整場交火，這正是編隊在沒有可靠空掩護下不敢戀戰的重要原因。艦隊本身的火力才是這場戰鬥的直接決定因素：南充號裝三門100毫米艦炮、四座雙聯37毫米高射炮與14.5毫米機槍，鷹潭號與湘潭號各裝兩座雙聯100毫米艦炮及四座雙聯37毫米高射炮，鷹潭號另攜「紅旗」六一型防空導彈發射架，湘潭號攜「上游」一型反艦導彈發射架，但這兩艘當時都屬實驗艦，發射架根本未裝彈，鷹潭號火炮膛蝕嚴重、主機使用小時亦已到壽命，因此整場交火中三艦一發導彈都沒有發射。越方最大的一條HQ-505是美國建造的LST登陸艦，原為LST-509「布洛克縣」號，一九七〇年移交南越海軍，一九七五年後由北越繼承並改稱「歸仁」號，配四座雙聯40毫米高炮；兩條武裝運輸船HQ-604、HQ-605則只有14.5毫米KPV重機槍。登礁與建設的裝備包括折疊式高腳屋鋼構件、水泥、砂石、柴油與淡水，由HQ-505的艙內裝載；中方在礁區的支援物資則由南拖147號拖船與後方基地補給船自湛江、海南方向運來。
kitsEn: The aircraft on the card, the J-8 II, was the only mass-produced high-altitude supersonic interceptor of the PLA Air Force. Entering service around 1980 with the fighter regiments under the aviation divisions, it carried a fire-control radar in its nose and could be loaded with infrared-guided air-to-air missiles such as the PL-4 and PL-5 series, and its task was interception, alert and air control in the high and fast regime; the J-7 and J-5 of the same period were built for medium and low altitude combat and for ground attack, and the division of labour was clear. In the clash at Johnson South Reef the J-8 II was not the weapon that sank the Vietnamese ships. Its role was to provide the far-seas task group with a first line of air alert and interception readiness: according to published postwar recollections, the air force and the naval air arm used J-8 IIs based in the north and around Hainan to stand by and to move into intercept position against any Vietnamese fighters that might scramble to reinforce. The type's combat radius was not short for an interceptor, and published figures commonly quote a figure of around 2,000 kilometres, varying with drop tanks and load, but the distance from bases such as Guangzhou, Zhanjiang and Sanya to the airspace over the Union Banks was still plainly beyond it, and the aircraft could not remain on station for the length of the engagement; that was why the group did not dare linger without reliable air cover. The naval guns decided the fight directly. Nanchong carried three 100 mm main guns, four twin 37 mm anti-aircraft guns and 14.5 mm machine guns; Yingtan and Xiangtan each carried two twin 100 mm guns and four twin 37 mm anti-aircraft guns, and Yingtan also mounted a HQ-61 surface-to-air missile launcher and Xiangtan a Shangliu-1 anti-ship missile launcher, but both were then experimental ships whose launchers carried no missiles, and Yingtan's gun barrels were badly corroded with its main engines already past their service hours, so not one missile was fired by any of the three ships in the action. The largest Vietnamese ship, HQ-505, was the American-built LST landing ship originally LST-509 Block County, handed over to the South Vietnamese navy in 1970 and inherited after 1975 by the north, which renamed it Quy Nhon; it mounted four twin 40 mm guns. The two armed transports HQ-604 and HQ-605 carried only 14.5 mm KPV heavy machine guns. The equipment for the landing and the construction included folded steel frames for the stilt houses, cement, sand and gravel, diesel fuel and fresh water, loaded in the hull of HQ-505, while Chinese support stores for the reef area came in on the tug Nantuo-147 and on the replenishment ships of the shore bases, from Zhanjiang and from Hainan.
tactics: 雙方在礁區的對峙有一套近乎本能的次序：先用護衛艦逼近與喊話施壓，再派武裝小組登礁插旗、劃定控制線，最後才動用艦炮。一九八八年三月十四日六時，越南海軍趁低潮登礁，HQ-604派出四十三人；中國海軍南充號派出三十三人、鷹潭號派出二十五人，合計五十八人，先後登上赤瓜礁。上午八時雙方在礁盤形成僵持，李楚群政委帶七名士兵駕小艇繞過越船逼近礁盤，砍斷繫住越軍登礁小船的纜繩，越方在礁上的退路被切斷；鷹潭號反潛兵班長杜祥厚隨即拔走插在礁上的越南國旗，兩國士兵在旗幟上扭打，最終槍響。八時四十七分，礁上雙方士兵互相射擊，越南HQ-604船上機槍隨即向礁盤掃射；八時四十八分，南充號主炮開火還擊，四分鐘後HQ-604起火，八分鐘後沉沒，越軍登礁人員四十餘人表示投降。鷹潭號與HQ-505在三十鏈距離上展開射擊，由於火炮後座震動，主炮火控雷達發生故障，全艦先後出現五十四起故障，修復不成，只射出幾十發炮彈即中斷射擊，越方登陸艦起火、炮位被毀，退往鬼喊礁搶灘擱淺。瓊礁方向，湘潭號於九時十五分在警告無效後向HQ-605開火，九時三十七分停止射擊，越船中彈起火、指揮台被擊毀、船體嚴重傾斜並進水，當晚沉沒。編隊在完成攻擊後立刻收回登礁人員，轉為外海機動佔位，遠離礁區待機，並為可能到來的越方增援預作準備。全程共耗100毫米炮彈二百八十五發、37毫米炮彈二百六十六發。空中方面，殲-8II始終沒有進入礁區上空的火力圈，它的作用是在外海方向攔截可能升空的越方戰機，掩護編隊撤出；由於空軍支援無法覆蓋，編隊在打沉兩船、打殘一船之後仍選擇迅速離開現場。
tacticsEn: The confrontation on the reef followed an almost instinctive order: naval frigates first closed in and hailed and pressured, then armed boats landed teams to plant flags and draw a line of control, and only afterwards were the guns used. At 06:00 on 14 March 1988 the Vietnamese navy landed on the reef at low tide, HQ-604 putting forty-three men ashore; the Chinese navy sent thirty-three from Nanchong and twenty-five from Yingtan, fifty-eight in all, onto Johnson South Reef. At eight o'clock the two sides were locked on the reef. Commissar Li Chuqun took seven soldiers in a small boat round the Vietnamese ship to close on the reef and had the mooring line of the Vietnamese landing boat cut, so that the Vietnamese on the reef lost their way off; the anti-submarine rating of Yingtan, Du Xianghou, then pulled the Vietnamese flag out of the reef, the two crews wrestled over it, and the shooting started. At 08:47 the soldiers on the reef fired at each other and the machine guns of HQ-604 swept the reef in support; at 08:48 Nanchong opened fire with her main guns in reply, HQ-604 was ablaze four minutes later and sank eight minutes after that, and more than forty Vietnamese who had landed indicated their surrender. Yingtan engaged HQ-505 at a range of thirty chains; because of the recoil shock the fire-control radar of the main guns failed, the ship registered fifty-four faults in all, the radar could not be repaired, the firing stopped after a few dozen shells, and the Vietnamese landing ship, on fire with its gun positions destroyed, turned and ran aground at Collins Reef. In the direction of Lansdowne Reef, Xiangtan opened fire on HQ-605 at 09:15 after its hail went unanswered and stopped shooting at 09:37; the Vietnamese ship was burning, its bridge destroyed, listing badly and shipping water, and it sank that night. The group then pulled its landing parties back, moved out to sea to take up waiting positions well away from the reef, and prepared for possible Vietnamese reinforcement. The action consumed 285 100 mm shells and 266 37 mm shells. In the air the J-8 II never entered the firing area over the reef; its task was to intercept any Vietnamese fighters that might scramble over the open sea and cover the group's withdrawal, and because air support could not reach the area, the group chose to leave quickly after sinking two ships and badly damaging a third.
data: 可以核對的數字集中在火力、排水量與傷亡三端。艦隊方面：南充號標準排水量約1150噸、最大航速22節；鷹潭號約1674噸、30節；湘潭號約1565噸、26節；三艦合計消耗100毫米炮彈285發、37毫米炮彈266發。越方三船：HQ-505標準排水量約1651噸、最大航速12節，配4座雙聯40毫米高炮；HQ-604與HQ-605排水量368噸、滿載822噸，只配14.5毫米KPV重機槍。登礁人數：越方三月十二日出動時共載運117名武裝人員，十四日晨實際登礁者為43人；中方登礁58人，南充號33人、鷹潭號25人。位置：HQ-505錨泊在赤瓜礁西北約1.5海里處的鬼喊礁，HQ-605在瓊礁東北約5海里處，與HQ-604夾住赤瓜礁；531與HQ-505交火距離為30鏈，約555公尺。時間線明確：三月十三日06時南充號出動，14時25分抵達；十四日06時30分鷹潭號、06時44分湘潭號抵達，08時47分接火，09時15分湘潭號開火，09時37分停止射擊。傷亡數字各方說法不一：中方統計本方僅楊志亮一人左臂中彈、無人陣亡，越軍死亡40餘人、被俘40餘人，內含中校軍官1人；越方則稱有64名士兵陣亡。俘虜數字的落差也有記錄：中方在礁上先接觸到40餘名越軍俘虜，因隨時防範越方增援而未及接收，之後返回礁盤時只剩9人，直到1991年9月2日才獲釋放。艦艇結局是HQ-604當場沉沒、HQ-605當晚沉沒、HQ-505重創後在鬼喊礁擱淺，同年7月12日拖帶時沉沒。殲-8II方面，公開資料常引其作戰半徑約2000公里上下，數值隨副油箱與載荷而變，說法並不完全一致；當日空軍實際出動架次與批次，各方記載有限，無從逐一核實。
dataEn: The verifiable figures cluster around weapons, displacement and casualties. On the Chinese side: Nanchong had a standard displacement of about 1,150 tons and a maximum speed of 22 knots; Yingtan about 1,674 tons and 30 knots; Xiangtan about 1,565 tons and 26 knots; the three ships together expended 285 100 mm shells and 266 37 mm shells. The three Vietnamese ships: HQ-505 of about 1,651 tons standard displacement and 12 knots maximum speed, mounting four twin 40 mm guns; HQ-604 and HQ-605 of 368 tons displacement and 822 tons fully loaded, armed only with 14.5 mm KPV heavy machine guns. Numbers ashore: the Vietnamese movement of 12 March carried 117 armed personnel in total, and 43 of them actually landed in the morning of the 14th; the Chinese landed 58, thirty-three from Nanchong and twenty-five from Yingtan. Positions: HQ-505 lay at anchor at Collins Reef, about 1.5 nautical miles north-west of Johnson South Reef, and HQ-605 at Lansdowne Reef, about 5 nautical miles north-east, so that the three ships bracketed Johnson South Reef; the range at which Yingtan engaged HQ-505 was thirty chains, roughly 555 metres. The timeline is precise: Nanchong sailed at 06:00 on 13 March and arrived at 14:25; Yingtan arrived at 06:30 and Xiangtan at 06:44 on the 14th; firing began at 08:47; Xiangtan opened fire at 09:15 and ceased shooting at 09:37. The casualty figures differ between the parties: the Chinese count only Yang Zhiliang, one man with a bullet through his left arm and no dead on their side, and put Vietnamese dead at more than forty with more than forty captured, including one lieutenant colonel; the Vietnamese account gives 64 soldiers killed, with a further figure of eleven men wounded. The gap in the prisoner figures is also on record: the Chinese first came on more than forty Vietnamese prisoners on the reef, had no time to take them in because they had to be ready for reinforcement, and when they returned to the reef only nine were left; they were not released until 2 September 1991. The fate of the ships was that HQ-604 sank on the spot, HQ-605 sank that night, and HQ-505, badly damaged, lay aground at Collins Reef and sank while under tow on 12 July of the same year. For the J-8 II, published figures commonly quote a combat radius of around 2,000 kilometres, varying with drop tanks and load and not entirely consistent between sources; the actual number of sorties and waves flown by the air force that day is poorly recorded on all sides and cannot be checked item by item.
cause: 衝突有兩條平行而互相作用的因果鏈。外交層面，一九七九年中越邊境戰爭之後兩國關係惡化，越南在蘇聯支援下鞏固對南沙的實際佔領，中國則在改革開放後急需把主權主張轉化為可以防守的實控點。一九八七年，聯合國教科文組織政府間海洋學委員會通過《全球海平面聯測計畫》，委託中國建立五個海洋觀測站，其中一個設在南沙群島；中國考察後選定永暑礁，一九八七年四月開始準備，一九八八年一月十四日把建站器材運抵，越南外交部隨即聲明要涉入反對。軍方當時在南沙確定了「不主動惹事、不首先開槍、不示弱、不吃虧、不丟臉面，敵佔我島要堅決趕走」的交鋒原則，這條原則決定了中方的戰術節奏：始終先對峙、後開火，開火後速撤，不在礁區戀戰。軍事層面，越南在赤瓜礁附近已有鬼喊礁與瓊礁作為支點，一九八八年一至二月海軍第一七一艦隊與一二五運輸旅先後派船搶佔中國海軍剛開展的永暑礁、華陽礁等礁盤，兩軍在礁上對峙近一個月。直接導火線是三月十二日越方一次多點同時的行動：三艘船同時前往赤瓜礁、鬼喊礁、瓊礁，載運117名武裝人員與高腳屋構件，試圖在最短時間內把三處礁點同時變成既成事實，中方判斷這是分散注意力、各個擊破式的搶灘，遂以三艦前出攔截。空中因素同樣真實：越方Su-22與米格系列戰機在北部基地待命，中方必須把攔截力量擺在北面，這正是殲-8II在此次行動中被推到前台的戰略原因。
causeEn: The clash grew out of two parallel and mutually reinforcing chains of causation. On the diplomatic level, relations between China and Vietnam had soured after the border war of 1979; Vietnam, backed by the Soviet Union, consolidated its de facto hold on the Spratlys, while China, in the years of reform and opening, had an urgent need to convert its claim to sovereignty into a defensible point of control. In 1987 the Intergovernmental Oceanographic Commission of UNESCO adopted the Global Sea Level Observing System programme and entrusted China with establishing five ocean observation stations, one of them in the Spratly Islands. After survey and patrol work China selected Fiery Cross Reef, began preparations in April 1987 and on 14 January 1988 brought construction material to the site, at which point the Vietnamese foreign ministry declared that it would intervene. The Chinese military had meanwhile settled on a set of principles for the Spratly contest: do not pick a fight, do not fire first, do not show weakness, do not suffer a loss, do not lose face, and if the enemy occupies our island, drive him out. Those principles set the Chinese tempo: confrontation first, guns second, and a quick withdrawal after the shooting rather than a prolonged fight on the reef. On the military level Vietnam already had Collins Reef and Lansdowne Reef as footholds near Johnson South Reef, and between January and February 1988 the 171st Flotilla and the 125th Transport Brigade sent ships to seize the reefs around Fiery Cross Reef and Huayang Reef where the Chinese were just establishing themselves, the two forces confronting one another on the reefs for close to a month. The immediate trigger was the multi-point, simultaneous Vietnamese move of 12 March: three ships bound at once for Johnson South Reef, Collins Reef and Lansdowne Reef, carrying 117 armed personnel and stilt house components, in an attempt to turn three reef positions into accomplished facts within the shortest possible time. The Chinese read it as a dispersed, fix-one-at-a-time landing, and sent the three frigates forward to intercept. The air factor was equally real: the Vietnamese Su-22 and MiG fighters stood by at bases in the north, so the Chinese had to place their interception force to the north as well, and that is precisely why the J-8 II was pushed to the foreground of this operation.
impact: 赤瓜礁一戰是中國在南海第一次把主權主張變成可以守住的實際控制。中方在此之前宣稱擁有南沙群島主權，卻沒有控制其中任何一個島礁；戰後不久便進駐永暑礁、華陽礁、東門礁、南薰礁、渚碧礁、赤瓜礁六處據點，補上了實控上的空白，一九八八年底前基本完成碼頭與高腳屋建設。越南的處境則相反：它在南沙的處境長期處於劣勢，但仍在群島西側控制包括鬼喊礁、瓊礁在內的二十多個島礁，到二零一二年可查的數字是29個有駐軍；越方利用HQ-505重創擱淺的殘骸在鬼喊礁搶灘，形成對赤瓜礁的夾擊，此後雙方在礁區的對峙從單次接觸變成長期共存的灰色地帶。區域與國際層面的反應同樣明顯：東南亞各國對中國在南海的推進普遍感到憂慮，但一九八八年正處中美關係的蜜月期，歐美與蘇聯都沒有介入；蘇聯因改善對華關係而不支持越南的求援提議，越南連要求派一艘供水油船都遭婉拒。中國在戰後刻意低調處理：外交部只向越南駐華使館遞交一份抗議照會，俘虜也非立即遣返，9名越軍俘虜直到1991年9月2日才獲釋放。軍事層面的教訓更為尖銳：陳偉文事後回憶強調，參戰護衛艦沒帶一枚可用的反艦或防空導彈，編隊在沒有空軍有效掩護的條件下只能速戰速決、隨即撤離；殲-8II這類高速截擊機的作戰半徑與基地佈局，決定了它在一九八〇年代末仍無法深入南沙礁區提供掩護，此後數年中國海軍才逐步建立以艦載機、岸基航空兵與後勤保障為核心的遠海作戰體系。
impactEn: The fight at Johnson South Reef was the first time China turned a claim to sovereignty in the South China Sea into an actual control it could defend. Before it, China claimed the Spratly Islands but held not one reef, islet or shoal among them. Within weeks of the action Chinese forces occupied six positions, Fiery Cross Reef, Huayang Reef, Dongmen Reef, Nanxun Reef, Zhubi Reef and Johnson South Reef, closing the gap in de facto control, and the docks and stilt houses were largely finished by the end of 1988. Vietnam's position ran the other way: long on the defensive in the Spratlys, it nevertheless still controlled more than twenty reefs on the western side of the group, including Collins Reef and Lansdowne Reef, and by 2012 the checkable figure was 29 reefs with stationed troops. Using the hulk of the badly damaged HQ-505, the Vietnamese rushed aground on Collins Reef, forming a pincer around Johnson South Reef, and the standoff in the area turned from a single collision into a long grey zone of coexisting positions. The regional and international reaction was equally clear: the states of Southeast Asia grew uniformly wary of China's advance in the South China Sea, but 1988 fell in the honeymoon period of Sino-American relations and neither the Western powers nor the Soviet Union intervened. The Soviet Union, improving its own relations with China, declined to support Vietnamese requests for help, and even a proposal to send a water and fuel tanker was turned down. China handled the aftermath deliberately quietly: the foreign ministry lodged only a note of protest with the Vietnamese embassy, prisoners were not returned immediately, and the nine Vietnamese prisoners in Chinese hands were released only on 2 September 1991. The military lesson was sharper still: in later recollections Chen Weiwen stressed that not one usable anti-ship or air-defence missile was carried by the frigates that fought, and that without effective air cover the group could only fight fast and leave at once. The combat radius and basing pattern of a high-speed interceptor such as the J-8 II meant that in the late 1980s it still could not penetrate to the Spratly reefs to provide cover; it took the Chinese navy several more years to build a far-seas warfare system built around carrier-borne aircraft, shore-based aviation and logistics.
result: 結果是中方全勝而戰場留了尾巴。一九八八年三月十四日，HQ-604在赤瓜礁外被擊沉，HQ-605在瓊礁方向中彈起火、當晚沉沒，HQ-505因火控雷達失效而重創起火，退往鬼喊礁搶灘擱淺，同年7月12日拖帶時沉沒；越方在礁上的登陸人員四十餘人被俘，中方一度因警戒增援而未及接收，第二次上礁時只剩9人。中方代價極小：南充號副槍炮長楊志亮左臂中彈，無人陣亡。三月十四日之後，赤瓜礁與其後的永暑礁、華陽礁、東門礁、南薰礁、渚碧礁六處礁盤實際落入中方控制，越方則退守鬼喊礁與瓊礁，兩國在九章群島形成南北對峙的長期態勢。編隊本身在完成攻擊後即撤出礁區，轉入外海待命，理由是當時解放軍空軍尚不能有效支援南沙海域作戰，顧忌越南空軍的空中報復；殲-8II這類高空高速截擊機在此役的角色因此被限定在警戒與攔截準備，既沒有、也無法在礁區上空發揮火力優勢。外交上，中方向越南駐華使館遞交抗議照會，處理保持低調，越方則把這場衝突稱為「長沙海戰」與「鬼鹿角礁事件」。事件的長尾效應在1994年的仁愛礁衝突中再次顯現：當中方以海警與軍艦主力推進時，菲律賓只作外交抗議而避免正面交火；南海島礁爭端自此成為中國與周邊國家長期、複雜、至今未解的結構性矛盾。
resultEn: The result was a Chinese victory with hooks left in the battlefield. On 14 March 1988 HQ-604 was sunk off Johnson South Reef, HQ-605 caught fire on the Lansdowne Reef side and sank that night, and HQ-505, its fire-control radar having failed, was badly burned, ran aground at Collins Reef and sank while under tow on 12 July of the same year. More than forty Vietnamese who had landed were taken prisoner; the Chinese had no time to collect them because they had to be ready for reinforcement, and when they returned to the reef only nine were left. The Chinese cost was minimal: the deputy gunnery officer of Nanchong, Yang Zhiliang, took a bullet through his left arm, and there were no Chinese dead. After 14 March, Johnson South Reef and then Fiery Cross Reef, Huayang Reef, Dongmen Reef, Nanxun Reef and Zhubi Reef passed into actual Chinese control, while the Vietnamese fell back on Collins Reef and Lansdowne Reef, leaving the two countries in a long north-south confrontation across the Union Banks. The group itself withdrew from the reef area as soon as the attack was over and moved out to sea to wait, the reason being that the PLA air force could not yet support operations in the Spratly area effectively and that a Vietnamese air reprisal was to be feared. The role of a high-altitude supersonic interceptor such as the J-8 II in this action was accordingly confined to alert and interception readiness; it neither did nor could fight for air superiority over the reef itself. Diplomatically, China lodged a note of protest with the Vietnamese embassy and kept the handling low-key, while Vietnam named the engagement the Battle of Trường Sa and the Gạc Ma incident. The long tail of the event showed itself again in the Mischief Reef confrontation of 1994, when Chinese coast guard and naval units advanced in force and the Philippines confined itself to a diplomatic protest rather than a direct clash; disputes over the reefs of the South China Sea have since become a structural contradiction between China and its neighbours, long, complicated and still unresolved.
